study_type: method development and retrospective comparison; all late curves previously exposed
time_scale: x=t_h/T_early_end_h; full-early T held fixed in rolling folds
numerical_unresolved: no successful finite fit, or any unsuccessful start RMSE is more than 1e-6 pp lower than best successful start; all starts retained

optimization.objective: unweighted SSE on positive early times, percentage-point scale
optimization.initialization: midpoint in normalized transformed bounds plus 32 uniform draws
optimization.seed_rule: (seed + int(first 8 SHA256 hex of curve_id+family+fold_suffix,16)) mod 2**32; full-fit fold_suffix empty matches external pipeline

rolling.score: sqrt(mean of squared errors over the same complete list of rolling target times))
rolling.candidate_failure: any missing/nonfinite or numerically unresolved fold excludes candidate from selector; retain all failed diagnostics
rolling.fallback: old4SSE when fewer than two folds or no CV-eligible full-fit-success candidate; record fallback, never count as successful rolling selection
rolling.final_full_fit_failure: choose next CV-ranked eligible candidate with successful full early fit; record skipped ranks
rolling.tie_break: listed candidate order within 1e-8 pp of minimum score

data.external_split: unchanged early and unsealed_late CSV from release_external_validation_20261021
data.structural_zero: retain and plot; exclude from objective and n
data.calcium_denominator: author-reported calcium-release percentage; experimental denominator and sampling details unresolved
data.kp_scope: all-early empirical capped power-law stress benchmark, not a validated application of early-release mechanism law; mark extrapolation beyond conventional early fraction domain

evaluation.primary: per-study mean late RMSE, then equal mean across four studies; compare each fixed selector and single method against same-pipeline old4SSE
evaluation.late_failure: late RMSE strictly greater than 10 pp
also_report: worst per-curve RMSE degradation vs old4SSE
rolling fallback counts and candidate eligibility
evaluation.success_description: descriptive improvement only if study-equal mean late RMSE is smaller; disclose failures, worst worsening and every study regardless; no confirmatory inference or reliable-method claim
prohibited: pooling calcium and cargo as biological equivalence

bridge.scenario: default parameters; medium EPR and MPS; default intracellular pH
bridge.kernel_family: F(a)=1-exp(-(a/tau)^beta), a is age after internalization
bridge.input: J_internalization + J_nonspecific_internalization from original unchanged V1.3 dynamics
bridge.units: normalized internalized-carrier-equivalent response, not measured cargo or free calcium
bridge.mapping: assumed response per unit internalized carrier, no fitted calcium parameter transfer and no Y_cargo update
bridge.interpretation: structural sensitivity of a fixed model-generated input to assumed waiting-time shape; no intervention or formulation optimization
bridge.negative_flux_clip: clip [-1e-10,0) only; preserve positive values; record count and minimum; fail below -1e-10
bridge.input_integral_reference: extra cumulative-J state integrated alongside original unchanged RHS

prohibitions: No overwrite outside this study folder
No real fitting until independent scope PASS
